directAnswer.en: This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. This electric row prints 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical and 60 m³/h. A shared model code on another page does not copy these two numbers across. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Electric 80 at 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical, aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm), hopper 0.7 m³, Kawasaki 140 double pump, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 6000 kg. The model cell also prints HBT80-1816-110. Do not move the same condition onto HBT80-16, which prints 110 kW, 50 m³/h, 40 MPa, horizontal conveying 120 m, delivery height 360 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm and 6500 kg. The model cell also prints HBT80-1816-110. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

heading.en: What the pour has to match

body.en: This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. This electric row prints 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical and 60 m³/h. A shared model code on another page does not copy these two numbers across. The published Electric 80 row is 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical, aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm), hopper 0.7 m³, Kawasaki 140 double pump, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 6000 kg. The model cell also prints HBT80-1816-110.
body.zh: 这是有电网、走管道的建筑浇筑。这一电动行印的是水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、60 m³/h。另一页上相同的型号代码，不能把这两个数字抄过去。已公布的电动80是110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）、料斗 0.7 m³、川崎 140 双泵、外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm、6000 kg。型号格同时印 HBT80-1816-110。

heading.en: Do not slide onto the neighbouring row

body.en: HBT80-16 prints 110 kW, 50 m³/h, 40 MPa, horizontal conveying 120 m, delivery height 360 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm and 6500 kg. The model cell also prints HBT80-1816-110. The shared job site in the photograph does not merge the two tables. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
body.zh: HBT80-16印的是110 kW、50 m³/h、40 MPa、水平输送 120 m、输送高度 360 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管内径 100 / 125 mm、外形 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm、6500 kg。型号格同时印 HBT80-1816-110。照片里的同类现场不能把两张表并成一张。这张照片来自一篇公开文章，只作这类工况的参照。它不是品锦的合同记录。本页不写项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。

body.en: Send the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical line you measured, and the supply the printed motor needs. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job, a price or a daily volume.
body.zh: 请发送配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及已印电机需要的电源。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。

question.en: Is the photograph a Pinjin jobsite?
question.zh: 这张照片是品锦的工地吗？

answer.en: No. It shows this kind of work. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not name it as a contract record.
answer.zh: 不是。它表示的是这类工况。河北品锦机械没有把它写成合同记录。

question.en: What does the Electric 80 row print for this check?
question.zh: 电动80这一行，这次要核对的数字是什么？

answer.en: This electric row prints 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical and 60 m³/h. A shared model code on another page does not copy these two numbers across.
answer.zh: 这一电动行印的是水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、60 m³/h。另一页上相同的型号代码，不能把这两个数字抄过去。

question.en: Is the printed output a contract volume?
question.zh: 印出的输送量是合同方量吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 80 prints theoretical catalogue figures only. This page names no floor, no contract volume and no price.
answer.zh: 不是。电动80只印理论目录数字。本页不写楼层、合同方量或价格。
